newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip rally falls short of record high close.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip rally falls short of record high close.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended higher Thursday as the August wholesale price report showed that inflation was under control, but the market was unable to sustain an early rally into record territory as Wall Street braced for Friday's retail price data.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 17.02 points at 5,771.94, though a rally to an intra-day high of 5,794.13 topped the record close of 5,778.00 set on May 22.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 2-1 on active volume of 401 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
